svg.text: A Visium spot is 55 µm across. Almost nothing in the body is 55 µm across.
Tissue, with the capture grid on top
⚠️ "CD3E and COL1A1 in the same spot"
does NOT mean one cell expresses both, and does
not by itself mean the two cells were touching.
→ this is why W8 exists: deconvolution.
Imaging platforms (Xenium, MERFISH, CosMx) do resolve single cells — at the cost of a targeted panel instead of the whole transcriptome.
